title: Productive family substitution preserves an event slot while changing one state
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. A repeated productive frame keeps participant, operation and argument order fixed while a licensed family substitution changes exactly one state/property slot; the exact whole residual remains a separate record of the resulting form. A complete passage must show the same event through several such state variants.

observations: GDT608 retains directed component backoff on held data but shows exact merge identity and pair-specific residuals remain necessary.
GDT754 corrected 172 productive-compound prose cards to composition axes and whole-form hypotheses, with zero component export and no source-literal reading.
GDT437 shows written component order changes formal transition signatures; the order is not discarded into semantic buckets.

mechanism.frame: A licensed family frame F fixes EVENT, OPERATION, PARTICIPANT, and ordered ARGUMENT slots. A substitution within one retained family changes one declared STATE/PROPERTY slot only.
mechanism.residual: The exact whole-form residual records the complete form identity and can select the state variant renderer, but it cannot create an unrelated participant or operation.
chain: F1 with one family substitution updates only state0 -> state1 on e.
F2 with another licensed substitution updates state1 -> state2 or emits a result; participant and argument order persist.
mechanism.rival: A whole-independent model treats F0, F1, and F2 as unrelated events or lets every substitution change any field.

design.complete_reading_consequence: In a complete three-clause passage, three forms sharing the same productive frame must yield one ordered participant/event chain with exactly one changing state field. A later form that reverses the written component order must swap argument slots rather than silently reuse the forward relation.
design.falsifier: On a predeclared complete passage with at least two licensed family substitutions, reject the model if a substitution changes operation or participant without a written trigger, if the same substitution has incompatible state effects in the same frame/context, or if state continuity requires an unprinted event.
design.strongest_failure: GDT608 and GDT754 establish formal composition and the need to quarantine analyst prose, not an independent state/property endpoint. The same family recurrence may be editorial packaging, and no target participant is independently bound.

predecessors.limit: Formal directed backoff; no semantic component values imported.
Productive prose was explicitly downgraded to axes/whole hypotheses; this card retains that ceiling.
Order-safe formal transitions, not target semantics.
Prior argument-type invariance failed because it had no independent endpoint; this card requires a complete-passage state-transition contrast.
Residual phase OPEN/UPDATE/CLOSE is different; this card tests family substitution of one state slot while preserving an event frame.

dependencies: At least two productive family substitutions must be independently licensed before fitting.
Participant/event continuity and the changed state field need a written complete-passage relation.
Whole-form residuals remain opaque identifiers; no component receives a letter, word, or Latin meaning.
Existing alternate-reader boundaries must remain fixed.
design.access: Retained reports and bounded duplicate checks only; no target data/image, reserve, GDT1001, source packet, decoder, experiment, route, ledger, or push.
